title: REQ · Frontend scaffold with runtime state hook and safe localStorage persistence
summary: useGame hook holds runtime state and persists it safely
description: Context: game/src/state/persistence.ts has serializeState/deserializeState; createInitialState and performAction exist in game/. Desired behavior: game/frontend/ is a Vite React TS project whose useGame hook loads the bedroom world from game/content YAML, restores saved state, saves on every change inside try/catch, and falls back to in-memory play when storage fails. Expected result: state survives remount; storage errors never crash. Why: persistence requirement of SG-3.
acceptance_criteria: Given saved state in localStorage, When the hook mounts, Then it returns that state
Given no saved state, When the hook mounts, Then it returns createInitialState with activeDialogue 'intro'
Given localStorage.setItem throws, When an action runs, Then state still updates and no error is thrown
Given corrupt saved JSON, When the hook mounts, Then initial state is used

out_of_scope: Contribution form and 'Suggest What Happens Next' flow
preserve: game/src/** engine, systems and state modules unchanged

technical_constraints: Reuse game/src runtime via imports; do not copy it
definition_of_done: Acceptance criteria demonstrated by unit tests
